arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} will pierce {c_number}[SF_17]{/c} additional time. 

{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} will additionally pierce up to {c_number}[SF_27]{/c} {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} enemies.

{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} combines all shards into a massive spike, dealing {c_number}[{SF_18}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage per shard. The spike explodes on impact and {c_important}{u}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage.

{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} launches a large thunderbolt that explodes on impact into {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} smaller seeking thunderbolt shards, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_DAMAGE_NORMAL}{/c} damage each.
{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_13 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage after piercing once.
{c_important}Ice Shards'{/c} Mana cost is reduced by {c_number}[SF_14]{/c}.
{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} launches {c_number}[SF_15]{/c} additional shard while you have a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u}.
{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_16 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to an enemy each time it hits them in the same cast.
